comparison.objective: Cue a record by placing the stylus in the gap before track three.
comparison.physical_skill: Grasp a 5 mm finger lift, follow a hinged tonearm arc, count visual track gaps, and lower the stylus gently and precisely.
comparison.success_condition: Stylus rests in the 109–113 mm target gap, arm still and hands clear; excessive touchdown speed or post-contact sliding permanently invalidates the trial.
comparison.reason: This tests gentle articulated placement onto a visually selected narrow target. It has no setscrew/collar manipulation or iterative dynamic-response criterion; its body provides the rubric despite no indexed spec versions.
